newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Andes confident of future - exec.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes confident of future - exec.

text.p: Executives at seafood firm Pacific Andes (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday its diversification into a broad-based marine resource development company and rising demand for its products would ensure earnings growth.
"I have good confidence in our future earnings because of the change in our earnings base," said executive director Ng Joo Siang.
Moving into "upstream" activities of seafood processing, sourcing and ship agency capabilities had given the company additional earnings potential, Ng said.

"It has helped improve our profitability," he told reporters after Hong Kong-based Pacific Andes announced its full year net profits to March 31 1997 rose 43 percent to HK$75.63 million from HK$58.79 a year earlier.

Ng said developing products from little used fish species like herring would also provide potential for growth into the Chinese market, where the company claims to have taken a 40 percent share for all imported frozen seafood products.
"We are constantly looking for new species and new fishing grounds to meet growing demand," he said.

The company was investing about US$10 million on two additional trawler vessels and was spending about US$20 million on investments in China and the United States to increase its presence in both markets, he said.
